audit.definition: Prescription check: ok · watch (missed once) · stale (asked 2+ sessions, never met) · impossible (implies an e1RM more than 8 kg above your best) · abandoned (no session in 21+ days).

starved.definition: A program day not trained for more than 7 days.

watch_sync.definition: Compared with what was last verified on your watch — no Garmin call.

est_time.definition: Estimated: sets × work time (≈3 s a rep, the prescribed time for timed work, both sides for per-side work, 20 s a power set) + the watch's rest between series + 30 s a lap between exercises + 90 s a warm-up set.

phase.definition: Phase in the day, in order: core block → power before the first main lift → the first loaded lift (strength) → timed and athletic work after it (functional) → the rest (hypertrophy). The program can name a phase itself.

next_target.definition: Double progression: the top of the range on every set earns the next step — barbell 2.5 kg, dumbbell 2 kg, dumbbell light 1 kg, cable 2.5 kg, machine 5 kg, plates 5 kg, added 2.5 kg (dumbbells per hand; plates on a machine).

planned_volume.definition: Working sets per muscle in one week of the program — every gym day once, optional days left out, warm-ups excluded. Speed, jump, throw, sled and rope work counts in the Athletic bucket, never as muscle volume.

e1rm.definition: Estimated 1-rep max (Epley): load × (1 + reps / 30), reps capped at 12. Per-hand lifts use the per-hand load; plate-loaded machines have none.
